item.title: Black Gift Boxes
item.description: A matte black surface under fingertips, a gold foil logo catching the light, a lid that lifts with the unhurried confidence of something built to be opened slowly: this is the visual and tactile language of premium gifting, and black executes it better than any other colour in packaging. Black gift boxes command attention without competing for it. They signal luxury through restraint, and they make whatever sits inside them look worth considerably more than its price tag.

item.title: Luxury Corporate Gift Boxes
item.description: A client opens a box at their desk, feels the weight of the lid, sees the logo embossed cleanly on the interior panel, and understands in that moment that the company who sent it operates at a different level. That understanding happens before a single product is removed. It is the entire purpose of investing in packaging that matches the relationship it represents.
